name: @mandusec/openclaw-inspect-plugin
description: Mandu U-LLM channel for OpenClaw: an OpenClaw PLUGIN TOOL exposing inspect_symbol (OpenClaw has no MCP client, so the inspect-mcp stdio server cannot mount — docs/design/testing/agent-e2e-harness.md §8). The security core is REUSED, not reimplemented: the tool calls interceptors/inspect-mcp/src/inspect-symbol.ts (resolve via arbiter → quarantined U-LLM → RE-SYMBOLIZE → emit) with the same ArbiterClientAdapter + ullm-client deps; only the mount layer (api.registerTool vs MCP JSON-RPC) is new. Fail-closed; success results are pure-symbolic. Zero runtime deps (loaded by OpenClaw via jiti as raw .ts).
